description: This file defines the LoggingFacade interface, which provides an abstraction for logging implementations. It includes method signatures for setting log levels and retrieving logger configurations.

classes.name: LoggingFacade
classes.description: An interface defining abstraction for logging implementations, providing methods to set log levels and retrieve logger configurations.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level for loggers based on the provided LoggerConfig.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves logger configurations for all loggers.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves logger configurations for specific loggers identified by their names.
